decision: Retract previous LOCKED/APPROVED claims for all 48 candidate injury tuples. Preserve them as evidence of the failed proposal only; the currently deployed 48 fixed-death and 30 dormancy XML entries remain untouched.

reasons.evidence: Seven classes chose arbitrary exposure duration and relative onset, then used D=delta*hours. Checking D/(A-T)==chosen hours is circular.
No day/night weather + recovery + per-species ecological exercise was performed before locking 48 values.
V1 wheat at -3C 24h predicts 97.62% survival while W13 22C untreated Moskovskaya39 observed 35±2% and Zlata 15±2%. Physiological acclimation absent.
V1 rice at +4C 240h predicts zero survival, unlike conditioned rice cohorts R02 at 88-100% survival; conditioning state absent. Laboratory-to-game time mapping remains uncertain.

Conditional maize M01 two-point fit yields onset -1.826C, making median lethal time at -1.9C 112.81h and at -2.0C 47.98h; two approximate 50% endpoints are insufficient to approve the temperature response.
Evergreen pine recuperates 0.003 injury per hour whenever ambient temperature >= -31C, even at -30C. The 'warmer than onset' rule was incorrectly accepted as demonstrated physiological repair.

Author request to determine numerical balance first did not validate assistant-generated species/group coefficients. Calling all 78 PASS conflated schema consistency with user-accepted biology/gameplay.

approval_requirements: Replace V1 guesses with source-or-gameplay-justified independently evaluated crop/climate scenarios, including variable temperature and warm spells; document source endpoint and physiological stage.
Reconcile non-acclimated versus acclimated wheat/rice and soil-versus-air differences without treating individual randomness as physiological memory; explicitly flag unmodeled biology.
Compare each 48 candidate profiles against independent winter climate/biome safety and user-visible consequences, using a bounded representative matrix by climate/biology, not made-up assertions.
Explicitly review steep near-onset response and nonfreezing recovery semantics; document baseline old-death migration implications.
Publish a new reviewed numerical table, not relabel failed V1 as source-calibrated; retain a clear author-level decision before production XML or release.
Use the existing native runtime acceptance only after integrated code/XML changes; engine-only 1.6 Pickle/Scribe PASS cannot certify new numerical values.
